ابتنيت (form VIII)
# اِبْتَنَيْتُ (ibtanaytu) /ib.ta.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اِبْتَنَيْتَ (ibtanayta) /ib.ta.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اِبْتَنَيْتِ (ibtanayti) /ib.ta.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اُبْتُنِيتُ (ubtunītu) /ub.tu.niː.tu/: first-person singular
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
